reviews.text: Great practice, vet natasha is always so welcoming. Friendly and helps my milo feel at ease. Reception also very friendly. Thank you

Well lit, good ambiance, relaxing to all pets, staff is friendly and professionals, very at ease when you go there, no long waiting time. You are served immediately. All in all I recommend this vet clinic

Bigger more spacious waiting room than the practice at Kippax. Lovely friendly receptionist and the vet was patient, really listened to my concerns, was very empathetic as well as knowledgeable and I didn't feel rushed to be in and out.
Very professional and pleasant vet,  lovely receptionist,  clean surgery.  Top marks.  Well recommended.  Thank you 😊 …

I wouldnt use this vet at all had two vets from same practice tell us totally different things about some blood results for our rescue dog, We went for a second opinion from another vet to find out which was correct and surprise they said exactly the same as Dogstrust had said when we adopted our dog and one vet from this practice. This vet is all about taking money for no valid reason and not the care of the animal. We also had to chase endless amounts of time to get a prescription signed receptionist lovely but the vets need assessing by a governing body in my opinion as the vets from one practice surely should all be saying the same thing and not contradicting each other. My pet deserves better and will get better then the service this practice can give

If you care and love your pets don’t bring them here.

My dog nearly died from shock from pain she was in because they didn’t listen to what I told them and the symptoms she was having.

Never really cared or looked into any issues we had, was just interested in making little progress and giving it more time to “see how things go” just so I come back pay for more visits and meds we didn’t need.

All they care for is money not your pets.
Very polite to us and very patient with my cat. Thankyou again
